meta.name: amazon-product-research
meta.description: Comprehensive product research and opportunity analysis for Amazon sellers. Analyzes demand, competition, profit potential, market entry barriers, and validates product ideas. Covers product sourcing, pricing strategy, and go-to-market planning. Use when the user asks about researching a product to sell, validating product ideas, product opportunity analysis, market research for Amazon, competition analysis, profit potential, should I sell this product, product viability, or any general product research questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊市场机会，验证产品盈利潜力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在亚马逊上寻找有利润空间的新产品
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Amazon market opportunities and validate product profit potential
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are looking for profitable new products to sell on Amazon

howto.what: 当用户询问亚马逊选品时，Claude 会进行全面的产品研究，包括需求分析、竞争评估、利润计算和市场进入策略，并输出一份结构化的机会评分报告。
howto.when: 当用户提出关于亚马逊选品、产品机会分析、竞争分析、利润潜力或产品可行性等问题时触发。

say.text: 研究“无线耳机”在亚马逊上的销售机会。
say.note: Claude 会分析该产品的需求、竞争和利润潜力。

say.text: 我想卖瑜伽垫，这个产品值得做吗？
say.note: Claude 会评估产品可行性并给出评分。

say.text: 对比“手机壳”和“手机支架”哪个更好卖。
say.note: Claude 会生成对比表格并推荐更优选项。

howto.what_en: When asked about Amazon product research, Claude performs comprehensive analysis including demand, competition, profit potential, and market entry strategy, outputting a structured opportunity score report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Amazon product research, opportunity analysis, competition, profit potential, or product viability.

say_en.text: Research "wireless earbuds" as a product opportunity on Amazon.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes demand, competition, and profit.

say_en.text: I want to sell yoga mats. Is this a good product?
say_en.note: Claude evaluates feasibility and scores it.

say_en.text: Compare "phone cases" vs "phone stands" for selling.
say_en.note: Claude generates a comparison table and recommends.
